say:2:1711102002:1.text: But before I hear your victory speech, would you like to hear about my dream from last night?
say:2:1711102002:1.source_cn: 不过，在听你的胜利感言之前，要不要先听听我昨夜的梦？

say:3:1711102003:1.text: That was... a long-lost, wonderful dream.
say:3:1711102003:1.source_cn: 那是一个……久违的奇妙美梦。

choice_prompt:4:1711102003.text: That was... a long-lost, wonderful dream.
choice_prompt:4:1711102003.source_cn: 那是一个……久违的奇妙美梦。

say:5:1711102004:1.text: Yes, I dreamt that I turned into a firefly.
say:5:1711102004:1.source_cn: 是的，我梦到自己变成了一只萤火虫。

choice_prompt:10:1711102009.text: At that moment, it seemed as if other fireflies were calling to me, but before I could see them clearly, I left the dream.
choice_prompt:10:1711102009.source_cn: 那时，似乎有其他的萤火虫在呼唤我，但我还未看清它们的身影，便离开了梦境。

say:12:1711102012:1.text: I can open my eyes calmly, instead of waking up in despair and fear.
say:12:1711102012:1.source_cn: 我能在平静的状态下睁开双眼，而不是在绝望和恐惧中惊厥着醒来。

say:14:1711102014:1.text: Alright, the dream is over. Merlin, tell me about your research on forbidden techniques.
say:14:1711102014:1.source_cn: 好了，梦醒了。梅林，告诉我你对禁术的研究吧。

choice_prompt:15:1711102014.text: Alright, the dream is over. Merlin, tell me about your research on forbidden techniques.
choice_prompt:15:1711102014.source_cn: 好了，梦醒了。梅林，告诉我你对禁术的研究吧。

say:18:1711102017:1.text: Therefore, you must tell her the price without reservation—
say:18:1711102017:1.source_cn: 所以，你必须把代价毫无保留地告诉她——

choice_prompt:19:1711102017.text: Therefore, you must tell her the price without reservation—
choice_prompt:19:1711102017.source_cn: 所以，你必须把代价毫无保留地告诉她——

say:20:1711102018:0.text: Although I feel guilty for failing Maxim's request, I am willing.
say:20:1711102018:0.source_cn: 尽管愧对于马克西姆的嘱托，但我愿意。

choice:19:0:1.text: Queen, would you be willing if you could no longer use magic?
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 王后，如果从此无法使用魔法，你愿意吗？

say:21:1711102019:0.text: Although I feel I have failed my teacher's guidance, I am willing to do so.
say:21:1711102019:0.source_cn: 尽管愧对于老师的教导，但我愿意。

choice:19:1:2.text: Modlyn, would you be willing if you could never have precognitive dreams again?
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 莫德琳，如果再也做不了预知梦，你愿意吗？

say:22:1711102020:0.text: Although I feel guilty for betraying your trust, I am willing.
say:22:1711102020:0.source_cn: 尽管愧对于你的信任，但我愿意。

choice:19:2:3.text: Gawain, would you be willing to lose your status as a magician?
choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 高文，如果失去魔法师的身份，你愿意吗？

say:24:1711102022:1.text: This means she will permanently lose the ability to cast spells, but will be able to save her life.
say:24:1711102022:1.source_cn: 这意味着，她将永久失去施法的能力，但能保住性命。

say:25:1711102023:1.text: I see… burning talent instead of lifespan. That’s a wonderfully gentle suggestion.
say:25:1711102023:1.source_cn: 原来如此……燃烧天赋而非寿命。这真是一个绝妙的温柔提议。

choice_prompt:26:1711102023.text: I see… burning talent instead of lifespan. That’s a wonderfully gentle suggestion.
choice_prompt:26:1711102023.source_cn: 原来如此……燃烧天赋而非寿命。这真是一个绝妙的温柔提议。

say:29:1711102026:1.text: For me now, how much use is magic?
say:29:1711102026:1.source_cn: 对于现在的我而言，魔法，还有多大的作用呢？

choice_prompt:31:1711102027.text: If it can be used to awaken Maxim, I think that would be its final and greatest achievement.
choice_prompt:31:1711102027.source_cn: 倘若能用它换来马克西姆的苏醒，我想，这便是它最后也是最大的功劳了。

say:32:1711102028:1.text: Having lost my magic, I am no longer a magician, and naturally, I can no longer bear the name of Gawain.
say:32:1711102028:1.source_cn: 失去了魔法，我便不再是一名魔法师，自然不能再坐拥高文之名。

say:34:1711102030:1.text: However, I believe you can find a more suitable successor.
say:34:1711102030:1.source_cn: 不过，我相信，你能找到更合适的继任者。

choice_prompt:35:1711102030.text: However, I believe you can find a more suitable successor.
choice_prompt:35:1711102030.source_cn: 不过，我相信，你能找到更合适的继任者。

say:36:1711102031:1.text: That's because you tolerated my willfulness. Thank you, Merlin.
say:36:1711102031:1.source_cn: 那也是你容忍了我的任性。感谢你，梅林。

choice_prompt:38:1711102032.text: I will always be your partner, and I will always remember every moment we've shared. As long as I live, Radiance will always be your ally.
choice_prompt:38:1711102032.source_cn: 我永远是你的伙伴，永远铭记与你经历过的点点滴滴，只要我生存于世，耀光永远是你的盟友。

say:39:1711102033:1.text: Actually, the reason I was so eager to wake Maxim up was also for Peggy's sake.
say:39:1711102033:1.source_cn: 其实，我这么急着救醒马克西姆，也是为了佩吉。

say:40:1711102034:1.text: Peggy is still young, but she already understands that the scepter and crown are not only an honor, but also a responsibility.
say:40:1711102034:1.source_cn: 佩吉年纪尚小，但她已经理解，权杖和王冠不仅是荣耀，更是责任。

say:43:1711102037:1.text: This is also a bit of my selfishness as a mother.
say:43:1711102037:1.source_cn: 这也是我身为母亲的一点私心。

choice_prompt:45:1711102038.text: Moreover, given the current situation, even if Peggy wanted to ascend the throne, she couldn't hold a proper coronation ceremony. Because the Emperor had taken the sword from the stone again…
choice_prompt:45:1711102038.source_cn: 何况，现在的局势，就算佩吉想继位，也无法举行正统的加冕仪式。因为大帝又拿走了石中剑……

say:46:1711102039:1.text: That's right. Without the sword in the stone as a witness, the new king's legitimacy would be questioned by the nobles.
say:46:1711102039:1.source_cn: 没错。没有石中剑的见证，新王的合法性会受到贵族们的质疑。

choice_prompt:48:1711102041.text: He took the real Sword in the Stone, and the sword in the Holy Antiquities was replaced by the fake sword we had previously replaced.
choice_prompt:48:1711102041.source_cn: 他带走了真正的石中剑，圣古堂里的剑又变成了我们之前替换过的伪剑。

say:49:1711102042:1.text: Very well, the Emperor has no ill intentions towards Yaoguang, perhaps he has had new considerations of his own.
say:49:1711102042:1.source_cn: 也好，大帝对耀光绝无恶意，或许是他自己又有了新的考量。

say:50:1711102043:1.text: So, I'll take this opportunity to make final preparations to ensure the operation goes perfectly.
say:50:1711102043:1.source_cn: 那么趁此时间，我也去做最后的准备，确保操作万无一失。

say:51:1711102044:1.text: Once everything is ready, we will proceed with the ceremony.
say:51:1711102044:1.source_cn: 等一切准备就绪，我们就进行仪式。

choice:48:0:1.source_cn: 是又发生了什么事情吗？

choice:48:1:2.text: Looks like I'll have to go ask him.

choice:45:0:1.text: Roland took the sword in the stone?

choice:38:0:1.text: Have you thought about how to explain this to Peggy?
choice:38:0:1.source_cn: 你有想过怎么跟佩吉交代吗？

choice:35:0:1.text: It seems you've made up your mind.

choice:31:0:1.text: But what about Gao Wen's seat?
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 可是，高文的席位怎么办？

choice:26:0:1.text: There's no going back. Have you thought it through?
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 没有后悔的余地，你想好了吗？

choice:19:3:4.text: —Then, pay the price with your magic.

say:54:1711102011:1.text: Really? But I don't feel sad.
say:54:1711102011:1.source_cn: 是吗？但我并不觉得悲伤。

say:55:1711102005:1.text: Perhaps it contains some revelation, but I think it's just an ordinary dream.
say:55:1711102005:1.source_cn: 也许它隐藏着某些启示，但我认为，那只是一个普通的美梦。
